assets.caption: EXHIBIT 16-19 — Nomograph for Absorbing Leg on Vessel Piping (Chart for Determining the Absorbing Leg on Vessel Piping)
assets.notes: Full-page nomograph rotated 90 degrees on the page. Five parallel scales: Nominal Diameter (inches), Pipe Stress (psi), Pipe Length, Pivot Line, and Total Thermal Expansion (inches). Reference points 3.1-3.5 with dashed construction lines illustrate the procedure.
